exposure: maternal history of induced abortion for nonmedical reasons
cohort: The study participants were multiparous women who gave birth to singleton babies at or after 28 weeks of gestation between December 1, 2015, and December 1, 2020.
finding: A history of induced abortion for nonmedical reasons was associated with increased risks of maternal and neonatal perinatal complications in subsequent pregnancies, with observed dose-effect relationships for these associations.
mod_finding: A history of induced abortion for nonmedical reasons was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section in subsequent pregnancies.
gest_age: at or after 28 weeks of gestation
